_provenance.role: one captured trait amplified — display-typography signature

amplifiedTrait.thesis: What if type was the interface — a strict modular scale and the full PP Neue Montreal weight range (200→600) the site owns but never exercises, doing all the structural work?
amplifiedTrait.capturedEvidence: _brand-extraction.json#type: single family across display/body/UI; weights [200,400,600] captured but headings render at 400 only; scaleAudit.kind = 'ad-hoc'.

modularScale.overrideRationale: B overrides the base 1.25 to 1.333 to give the display steps real drama while remaining a fixed modular system. This is a type-axis amplification of a captured trait, not size-as-personality: the trait being amplified is the single-family display signature, and the scale discipline directly retires the captured ad-hoc scale (T-scale).

structuralDeltasVsA: Hero is type-led (letterforms ARE the composition); A's hero pairs the manifesto headline with a concrete product-moment panel — different hero layout strategy.
Mid-page type-specimen ladder replaces the investor-text + team-grid sections that A retains in restrained form — different section layout strategy / presence.
Constellation motif suppressed (near-static faint backdrop or removed) so type owns the page; A reprises it lightly as a recurring accent — different motif treatment.
extensions.improvementsHonored: All five base improvements honored as a floor; B goes further on #3 (full weight range + strict scale) and re-routes #4/#5 through type rather than restrained logo/portrait treatment.

checks.evidence: Amplification is the captured single-family display signature exercised across its full captured weight range + a fixed modular scale; large sizes are a consequence of the scale, not the personality.
'Specimen' is a type-craft term, not editorial costume; no 'atelier/journal/studio' vocabulary. Copy stays in the captured manifesto voice.

iaPriorities.constraint: IA spine preserved; mid-page sections re-typeset as a specimen ladder, not re-sequenced — hero stays hero, closing CTA stays terminal

narrative.overview: Variant B amplifies the captured display-typography signature: one private typeface that already carries display, body and UI, but renders at weight 400 only on an ad-hoc scale in the captured site. B exercises the full 200→600 weight range and a strict 1.333 modular scale, and lets oversized type — not imagery — do all the structural work. Static; palette, typeface, IA spine all pinned.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface across the full captured weight range (200 / 400 / 600).
Strict modular scale at ratio 1.333 (perfect fourth).
Type-led hero: letterforms are the composition, not a particle field.
Mid-page type-specimen ladder replaces the slider/strip sections.

rules.name: The Full-Range Rule
rules.body: All three captured weights (200/400/600) are in play on every long section: Light body, Regular sub-heads, SemiBold heads. Weight-400-only flatness is retired.

rules.name: The Modular-Scale Rule
rules.body: Ratio 1.333 override of the base 1.25. Every step is a power of the perfect fourth; no ad-hoc sizes.

dos: Do exercise all three captured weights (200/400/600) on every long section.
Do let oversized type be the layout; negative space is the second material.
Do keep the IA spine and the single 'Request Access' funnel intact.
donts: Don't read B as 'A but bigger fonts'.
Don't add imagery to compensate; type carries the page.
Don't exceed 64px desktop section padding even with oversized type.
